description: For reviews of CI savings, skip-lane, or path-filter plans, list every workflow that fires on the same pull_request/synchronize head SHA, split runner and wall minutes by workflow, and require the plan either to change those siblings or to lower its target. Treat an unmentioned same-event workflow that exceeds the claimed p50 as a plan defect. Do not implement a new skip-lane in this item; this is the review-protocol and acceptance-arithmetic change only.

verifications.description: Protocol requires enumerating same-event sibling workflows
